summary: Minimal, correct fix that makes renderer optional in AnchoredLocatorBase.__call__ and resolves it from ax.figure when None, exactly matching the traceback's failure path during tight-bbox save. Resolves the issue without regression or compatibility concerns.

issues.description: Relies on private API ax.figure._get_renderer(); acceptable since this is internal mpl_toolkits code already coupled to such internals, but ties the locator to that private method.
